hook: Hyderabad sweets got 'silver' leaf that was *aluminium*, police say
hook_b: Hyderabad sweets got 'silver' leaf that was *aluminium*, police say
tldr: The Commissioner's Task Force raided four units it says passed aluminium leaves off as edible silver waraq, supplied to sweet makers and bakeries.

beats.what: Police seized 49 bundles of aluminium leaves, 10 kg of aluminium flakes, coated sugar balls and other materials.
beats.why: Police said the fake waraq went on Kaju Katli, Kaju Rolls and Cham Cham, and aluminium flakes into zarda and flavoured paan.
beats.care: Police cautioned that long-term intake of non-food-grade aluminium may harm the kidneys, nerves, bones and digestion.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 17): The units were allegedly running without valid FSSAI licences, said Commissioner MM Bhagwath.
